limits: All 28 assigned packets were read in the assigned order and their supplied SHA-256 values verified. An initially truncated display of P003/P023/P014 was recovered from those same permitted files. Only the assigned prompt, D2 case/archive and listed packets informed judgments.

Novelty is relative to the frozen incomplete archive. Related archive matches on a new family identify precursors, not equivalence. Mere analogy, changed material representation, named obligations or combined familiar operations did not earn novelty.

A raw opening may contain several ordinary operations. Its family records the defining mechanism/question; F10 and F05 represent additive combinations, F16 the untested incentive edge, and P018 A2 also contains F13 local-pair diagnostics. F09 is reserved for an explicit beyond-additive prediction.

Fit scores concern the stated bounded next probe, with supplied hard commitments retained. Unverified efficacy, geometry performance, customer willingness or later production costing alone does not make a gated sample probe a violation. No proposal explicitly relaxes a supplied hard commitment; changing preassembly is permitted. Shared scarce samples/participants require allocation, as the post texts generally acknowledge.

All raw causal openings connect directly to at least one named outcome or adoption decision; none constitutes empirical proof. Observability 1 marks the unisolated incentive/feedback edge even where its familiar operational component has concrete measurements. Support labels describe causal claims, not the stipulated observations that motivate them.

Every raw opening remains intelligibly represented after Distill, including optional/deprioritized alternatives; retained does not mean recommended for adoption. No intelligible new mechanism family appears only after Distill. No hard-constraint violation is recommended.

P015 post decision substitutes nine-of-ten participant success into pilot acceptance wording. That small screen cannot establish success for the 60-order customer cohort. It is not a newly invented mechanism or a supplied hard-constraint violation.

P025 Z2 incorrectly treats persistent mechanical failures as weakening diagram guidance despite separately recording placement. Distill preserves the guidance relation but improves that distinction; this fluency correction was not awarded novelty.

Factorial and multiple-probe packets compete for ten first-use participants; sequential reuse cannot recreate independent first use. Distill preserves mechanisms but does not supply a fully powered allocation. Screening is not proof of prevalence, interaction, pilot success or real-world outcomes.
No actual-world outcome was measured. No condition mapping, operator instructions, other cases, peer judgment, web material or agent consultation was used.
